name: Deloitte

Software Engineer (India, entry).dsaDepth: Light–Moderate — an aptitude test first, then technical rounds that can range from basic array/string questions to full HLD/LLD design discussions depending on the team/project
rounds: Aptitude test: logical, quantitative and verbal reasoning
Technical round(s) (1-2): DSA questions ranging from simple (string traversal, array reversal) to complex (a full system design covering HLD and LLD with trade-off discussion, for some pipelines)
Behavioral/HR round: communication and cultural fit, sometimes a case study for problem-solving demonstration
extraTopics: Adaptability — reports show a very wide range from "simple, basic questions" to full HLD/LLD design in round 2, so the actual bar depends heavily on team/project staffing
Language-specific fundamentals tied to your resume (Python, Java, OOP, databases all reported)

Consultant / Senior Software Engineer.dsaDepth: Moderate — 2 technical rounds, a managerial round, and sometimes a distinct "Versant" (spoken-English assessment) round
rounds: 2 technical rounds: resume-driven, language-specific (Java, SQL, testing frameworks)
Versant round (automated spoken-English/communication assessment) for some pipelines
extraTopics: Spoken English assessment (Versant) — a format specific to consulting-style client-facing roles, not common at product companies
